captured_turns.narration:
You look around the tavern carefully. Near the **fireplace**, Aulus stands with his drink held low, watching the room and keeping the three guards in his peripheral sight.

Bassus remains by the fireplace, scanning patrons and exits, then shifting his stance to keep the loose knot of guards in view while the tavernkeeper continues his work.

Cato also watches from by the fireplace, moving his eyes over the patrons and exits. His short sword stays sheathed, and his stance remains ready as the guards share wine.

npc_turns.action: I stand near the fireplace with my drink held low, eyes sweeping the room—no sudden movements—while I keep the three guards in my peripheral sight and listen for trouble.
I scan the room from my post by the fireplace, eyes moving from patrons to exits, then shift my stance to keep the loose knot of guards in view while the tavernkeeper continues his work.
I watch the room from my post by the fireplace, eyes moving over patrons and exits, keeping my short sword sheathed and my stance ready as the guards share wine.

captured_turns.narration:
You punch Aulus in the face, but he is already in motion. His hand snaps up, wine sloshing as he steps in tight, short sword half-drawn, guard’s stance set to intercept.

He drives in before you can complete the strike. Your blow does not land cleanly; instead, his weight and timing take you, and you are forced down and pinned there. Aulus’s eyes stay on you as he says, “You—back off. I saw what you did.”

Cato wedges himself between you and the guards, steel angled low while his free hand grips the guard-strap on his chest to call attention.

dialogue.response: You swing for my face—too fast, too close. I’m overpowered; my feet slide back as you drive in. Before I can reset, you counter—my body goes pinned under your force, breath knocked hard, and I can only twist and grit my teeth as you land the decisive follow-through.

I’m already watching your hands—too close. I lunge in hard with my short sword arm tight, shoulder driving forward; you’re quicker, but my weight and timing take you—your feet catch back as I slam you down and pin you there, blade kept clear at your side, breath loud in your ear. Stay still. Quietly.
